company.name: Slauth.io
company.shortDescription: Slauth.io is an IAM Policy Copilot that suggests secure IAM policies
company.description: Slauth.io is an IAM Policy Copilot that suggests secure IAM policies based on the observed activity of a newly developed service identity i.e. micro-service. As opposed to a DevOps engineer having to manually write a policy and hope it is secure, Slauth suggests the most secure policy through a PR within seconds. We save DevOps engineers countless of hours and reduce technical debt which results in security vulnerabilities. Integrations with Terraform are also available.

productsAndServices.description: A tool that auto-generates least-privilege IAM policies for AWS and GCP environments by analyzing code using language learning models and traditional scanning.
productsAndServices.name: IAM Policy Copilot

productsAndServices.description: A command-line interface tool that scans code locally and generates secure IAM policies for AWS and GCP, integrating with CI/CD workflows.
